name: MAC Mobility | Cross-Domain Suppression | Blackhole+Shutdown+Suppress Sanctions
status_note: G4 wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 cross_domain_sanction_assert handler. Handler (1) commits the loop-prevention action via get_persistent_ssh_session, (2) runs N alternating RT-2 injections to drive the cross-domain flap, (3) verdict PASS if both steps succeed. DNOS 26.2 live-validated action keywords: blackhole / shutdown / suppress (NOT drop / freeze -- those fail commit-check, see runtime_corrections.json:dnos_26_2_loop_prevention_action).
redesign_note: Original test required PW data plane for AC<->PW rapid flapping. PW is BNI in SI mode. Redesigned to test cross-domain suppression using AC <-> Remote EVPN rapid flapping via Spirent. SC04 redesigned from PW<->PW (no suppression) to Remote<->Remote (no suppression). The suppression engine behavior is the same regardless of whether the cross-domain move is AC<->PW or AC<->RemoteEVPN. Wiring (2026-04-21): blackhole replaces 'drop' keyword (drop is not DNOS 26.2 syntax).
gap_rationale: The meeting notes state that for cross-domain MAC moves, only Drop and Shutdown sanctions are valid. Suppress/Freeze behavior for cross-domain moves needs verification. No existing test validates suppression behavior on AC<->RemoteEVPN specifically.

prerequisites.check_command: show config network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling | no-more

config_before_test.description: EVPN SI instance with at least 1 AC and Spirent EVPN_RR_Peer. MAC suppression enabled. The cross_domain_sanction_assert handler itself commits the sanction action per scenario before driving the flap.

suppression_config_template.blackhole: network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling loop-prevention action blackhole
suppression_config_template.shutdown: network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling loop-prevention action shutdown
suppression_config_template.suppress: network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling loop-prevention action suppress

scenarios.name: AC<->RemoteEVPN rapid flap with BLACKHOLE sanction -> MAC blackholed
scenarios.what_happens: Configure sanction=blackhole. Rapidly alternate: Spirent RT-2 injection with incrementing seq numbers. Repeat to trigger suppression threshold. MAC should be blackholed. The cross_domain_sanction_assert handler itself commits the sanction config via persistent SSH before driving the flap.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Freeze applied. MAC frozen on incorrect interface.

trigger.note: Handler: cross_domain_sanction_assert -> commit sanction then Spirent flap.

show evpn instance {evpn_name} loop-prevention mac-table | no-more

scenarios.name: AC<->RemoteEVPN rapid flap with SHUTDOWN sanction -> Interface shut
scenarios.what_happens: Configure sanction=shutdown. Rapid AC<->RemoteEVPN flap. The AC interface should be shut down. Handler commits sanction + drives flap.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Freeze applied. Remote peer shut (only local AC can be shut).

trigger.note: Handler: cross_domain_sanction_assert -> commit sanction then Spirent flap.

scenarios.name: AC<->RemoteEVPN with SUPPRESS sanction -> document actual behavior
scenarios.what_happens: Configure sanction=suppress (DNOS 26.2 default). Rapid AC<->RemoteEVPN flap. Document whether suppress/freeze applies to cross-domain moves or falls back to blackhole. This is gap-analysis behavior documentation. Handler commits sanction + drives flap.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: PW frozen (no PW). Service permanently disrupted.

scenarios.name: Remote<->Remote moves -> suppression NOT triggered
scenarios.what_happens: Rapidly inject same MAC via Spirent RT-2 with incrementing seq numbers (simulating remote-to-remote moves). Per SW-192019: remote-to-remote moves do NOT trigger suppression. No sanction should apply regardless of configured action. Handler re-commits sanction=suppress (the residual state from SC03) and runs the flap.

trigger.note: Handler: cross_domain_sanction_assert -> suppression action configured but remote-to-remote moves should NOT trigger sanction per SW-192019.
